question: What cost of owning a home shows up in the job market rather than on any bill?
answer: Owners move less, so they are slower to follow work. Two economists found that US states where home ownership rose later saw higher unemployment, longer commutes and fewer new firms, a link still debated. Selling a house takes months and several percent in fees; a renter can leave in weeks.
move: Value the freedom to leave as well as the thing you hold.
